_note: Kokoro (kokoro-js, espeak-ng en-us) pronunciation overrides for the shorts – US accent, Kokoro phoneme notation (ˈ stress, ɹ, ɚ, ɾ). Used by scripts/cine/tts.mjs; checked by scripts/video/tpl/pron.mjs audit (voice gate) and the ASR back-check in qc_v9. Add a word only with a dictionary source in 'why'. Keys = lower-case word form.

comfortable.why: espeak says /ˈkʌmftəbəl/ (no r, British); US 3-beat form KUMF-ter-ble (Merriam-Webster \ˈkəm(p)f-tər-bəl\, Cambridge US) – the pron lesson teaches 3 beats

vegetable.why: espeak says 4 beats /ˈvedʒɪɾəbəl/; US/UK 3 beats VEJ-tuh-ble (CMUdict V EH1 JH T AH0 B AH0 L, Cambridge) – the pron lesson teaches 3 beats

email.why: espeak is right (EE-mail, Cambridge/Merriam-Webster); CMUdict marks e-MAIL (IY0 M EY1 L) – listed so the audit uses the dictionary stress

marry.why: espeak says /ˈmæri/ (marry ≠ merry accent); General American merges them: /ˈmeri/ (Merriam-Webster \ˈmer-ē\, Cambridge US, CMUdict M EH1 R IY0)

married.why: past tense of marry – same General American /ˈmerid/ (Merriam-Webster, Cambridge US)
